basic_info.description: This charming Edwardian-style fourplex, located in the heart of Cole Valley, offers an exceptional opportunity for both investors and owner-occupants. The property features a new roof, and three of the four units have been recently updated with fresh paint, new appliances, flooring, and modernized kitchens and bathrooms. The upper 2-bedroom unit is filled with natural light and includes an oversized primary bedroom, a dedicated office space, and a remodeled bathroom. The studio unit, also recently renovated, has its own street-level entrance, and both 1-bedroom units offer spacious living rooms. The downstairs 1-bedroom features a new quartz kitchen countertop and a bonus room. The building boasts a serene courtyard perfect for outdoor relaxation. Conveniently located near UCSF, Cole Street's shops and restaurants, Golden Gate Park, St. Mary's Hospital and USF with easy access to public transportation, this fourplex is a rare opportunity to experience the best of San Francisco living.
